test_title: PYST 6:SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On:17 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The Indian independence movement sought to establish the __conceptions of freedom__ and social welfare as the goals of an independent Indian state, resulting in Fundamental Rights and Directive Principles.
solution:
The correct answer is: **concepts of liberty**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence talks about how the Indian independence movement aimed to establish specific goals for an independent India.
 
• The goals were "conceptions of freedom and social welfare".
 
• These goals resulted in the creation of **Fundamental Rights** and **Directive Principles**.
 
• The word "conceptions" can be replaced with "concepts" without changing the meaning of the sentence.
 
• "**Liberty**" is a synonym for "**freedom**", so "**concepts of liberty**" is an appropriate substitution.

Hence, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Procedures of free mind**" does not make sense in the context of the sentence.
 
• "**Symbols of victory**" is not related to the goals of the Indian independence movement.
 
• "**Methods to sympathise**" is not related to the goals of the Indian independence movement.
